name: RPA Challenge - Form
description: RPA Challenge (https://rpachallenge.com/) input form: launches Chrome with a dedicated robot profile, fills the form fields and reads them back.

elements.name: Home - Start Button
elements.rationale: The only large button of the page; its id and name change on every load.

elements.name: Form - First Name Field
elements.rationale: Fields move and get random ids and names on every round; the Angular binding name (ng-reflect-name) is the stable business attribute.

actions.name: Launch
actions.description: Launches Chrome on RPA Challenge with the robot profile and waits for the home page (START button).

onTimeout.detail: RPA Challenge home page did not load (START button not found)

actions.name: Set Field First Name
actions.description: Writes the First Name field, then reads it back so the caller can check the value.

outputs.name: First Name Read Back
outputs.description: Value of the field after writing

onTimeout.detail: First Name field not found by its CSS selector

actions.name: Get Start Text
actions.description: Reads the label of the START button.
